status_semantics.partial: Some evidence exists but acceptance is incomplete.
status_semantics.implemented: Code path exists; verification/validation is not implied.
status_semantics.qualified: All applicable implementation, verification and validation gates are satisfied.

packages.name: Temporal discretisation
gaps: production `advance_time` still uses an implicit Picard iteration and is therefore limited to `dt = O(h)` on spatially fine operators; this is a production implicit-solver robustness limitation, not a missing temporal-order verification
broader production transient qualification beyond the current closure corridor

packages.name: Time-step, CFL and pseudo-time
gaps: broader production time-step/CFL qualification beyond the currently verified controller and dual-time lifecycle corridor

packages.name: Nonlinear solver and convergence
gaps: automatic initialization strategies remain intentionally unqualified; provided/uniform/restart are the declared validated modes
continuation failure/recovery remains unit-qualified but is not yet part of the canonical Re=100 qualification corridor
qualification breadth beyond the Re=100 lid-driven cavity, including broader geometries/meshes and parameter corridors

spatial observed-order evidence is merge-gated only as a 16/32/64 trend tripwire (tests/validation/test_ghia_cavity.cpp --gate, order U_RMS=2.05, V_RMS=1.16); the full 32/64/128 plus Re=400/Re=1000 campaign runs weekly on schedule and establishes neither the spatial accuracy of the continuation or adaptive paths nor a general order on other schemes, meshes or geometries

packages.name: Linear solver and preconditioner ecosystem
gaps: the SchurApproximation abstraction is now production-reachable through PCD (steady_incompressible_solver.h constructs PcdSchurApproximation and includes coupled_amg_schur.h -> pcd_schur.h -> schur_approximation.h), so the earlier claim is superseded. The exact oracle, SIMPLE/SIMPLEC and LSC/BFBt approximations remain test-only, and no case-file or solver-options setting selects them, so the approximations qualified against the oracle cannot be run by a production case. A production case selects PCD, or the separate CoupledBlockSchur/MGR preconditioners

the PCD Schur approximation is implemented, production-wired and unit-tested against an independently assembled oracle (src/cfdx/core/linalg/pcd_schur.h, #635), and it passes the pressure-velocity matrix with the same gates as BlockSchur and MGR. What is open is its operator ordering: -Fp^{-1} and -Kp^{-1} are untested on a non-zero-convection case, and numerical_method_registry.h correctly still records preconditioner.pcd as Planned
only a constant (mean-zero) pressure null-space policy exists in the Schur layer; pinned pressure is handled in production by a separate gauge-elimination mechanism that the Schur layer does not use
measured matrix characteristics (anisotropy, coefficient range, numerical symmetry and saddle-point structure) are not yet fed to the dispatcher from assembled matrices
anisotropic and strongly scaled AMG campaign is incomplete
Schur acceptance envelope is not yet established on representative CFD matrices

rules.rule: Implementation registry entries do not imply validation.
Limiter coefficient tests do not by themselves qualify convection schemes.
Approximate Schur is not exact Schur.
Residual convergence does not replace conservation, boundedness or QoI evidence.
Backend support does not imply numerical equivalence.
